# ReadyClaw
> Pre-configured AI systems delivered on a Mac mini — local or cloud. Plug in, log in, done. From €899 one-time, no subscription.

## What it does
- Email triage (overnight sort + draft replies) · Calendar prep (briefing before each meeting) · Document Q&A (ask your files, answers with sources)

## Packages (one-time, hardware incl., lifetime ownership)
- Basic €899 · Custom from €1,199 · Jarvis €2,499 (100% local, GDPR-defensible) · optional support Free / €19.95 / €99.95 per month

## FAQ
Q: Is there a subscription? A: No — one-time from €899 with lifetime hardware ownership; support is optional.
Q: Does my data stay private? A: The Jarvis tier runs 100% locally (GDPR-defensible); cloud tiers use your own AI key.
Q: How long until it works? A: Configured and delivered in about 5 days, with a 30-minute remote onboarding.
Q: I already own a Mac mini? A: They configure it remotely and deduct the hardware cost.
